title: Instrument shopping list services and sheet lifecycle
description: Add structured logs around shopping-list orchestration and sheet lifecycle, covering append/create flows, aggregator outcomes, and sheet open/add actions. If `EditItemSheet` is present in this worktree, include the requested lifecycle logs there as well.
acceptance_criteria: `AddToShoppingListService.append(...)` and `.create(...)` log entry context and exit outcome, including relevant counts.
Any helper write/orchestration path in `AddToShoppingListService` logs success or failure without changing control flow.
`AddToShoppingListSheet` and `AddItemSheet` log the requested sheet lifecycle and add-action context.
If `EditItemSheet` exists at implementation time, the requested logs are added there; otherwise the bead notes that it was intentionally skipped.

handoff_summary.completed: AddToShoppingListService.append: entry (recipe, file) + exit (itemCount, file) + warning on readFailed and writeFailed. AddToShoppingListService.create: entry (name, recipe) + exit (itemCount, file) + warning on listAlreadyExists and writeFailed. AddToShoppingListSheet: onAppear lifecycle, loadLists count, appendToExisting entry/success/errors, handleCreate entry/success/errors. AddItemSheet: onAppear lifecycle, handleAdd entry (item, aisle). import os added to all three files.
handoff_summary.remaining: EditItemSheet did not exist at implementation time — skipped per bead spec. No other remaining work.
handoff_summary.risks: None. Control flow is unchanged; all log calls are fire-and-forget debug/warning statements. SourceKit module diagnostics are pre-existing worktree IDE resolution issues, not real build failures.
handoff_summary.next_action: Ready for tester agent to validate acceptance criteria.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: No file-scope conflicts expected. All changed files are leaf views/services with no sibling bead claims.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Followed the exact log format established by ShoppingListFiles.swift: [ClassName] method: key=value with privacy: .public on all user-visible string interpolations. Warning level used for all error paths; debug for entry/exit. import os added alongside existing imports without changing module order beyond alphabetical placement.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests added per bead scope. Logging is observability-only and does not alter control flow, so existing tests remain valid.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: EditItemSheet.swift was absent from the worktree at implementation time and is intentionally skipped. If it is added in a future bead, the same logging pattern should be applied then.

conflict_risks: No file-scope conflicts expected. All changed files are leaf views/services with no sibling bead claims.

execution_history.summary: Added structured `os.Logger` instrumentation to AddToShoppingListService, AddToShoppingListSheet, and AddItemSheet. All logs use Loggers.shoppingLists with the established [ClassName] method: key=value pattern. EditItemSheet was not present in the worktree and is intentionally skipped.
